evals.prompt: Add a `markWorn(itemId)` application service to the closet module that records a wear event and updates the item's last-worn date, per docs/modules/closet.md's planned `wear_events` table.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs `git ls-files apps/api/src/modules/closet`, finds a P02 skeleton (empty `ClosetModule`, no `internal/schema.ts`, no `wear_events` table; P07 is NOT_STARTED in planning/PROGRESS.md) and stops before inventing storage, routing the table to `db-migration`. Any code it does write (for example a pure wear rule) lives under apps/api/src/modules/closet/internal/, takes `now` as a parameter instead of importing the platform Clock, copies the named siblings (closet.smoke.test.ts, storage.port.test.ts), and is exported from index.ts only if docs/modules/closet.md declares it public.
assertions: The agent checks what exists (git ls-files or equivalent) and reports that closet is a P02 skeleton with no schema.ts and no wear_events table
The agent stops or defers the persistence part and names `db-migration` (and the P07 wear-events task) instead of inventing a table or a parallel store
Any rule it writes takes the current time as a parameter and does not import apps/api/src/platform/** (modules-not-platform applies to tests too)
The report names the sibling files it copied and `just test closet` as the command it ran, with real output
The report states whether docs/modules/closet.md needed updating and why

evals.prompt: The billing module needs to read a customer's active plan when closet enforces an item-count cap on free-tier users. Wire that up.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks `ALLOWED_EDGES` in tools/depcruise/rules.cjs, finds that closet may import only profile and media, and stops: closet cannot read billing's plan through any import, public or internal. It notes that the entitlement name `closet.max_items` already exists in packages/shared-kernel/registry/entitlements.json and reports the edge question (ADR, or gating at the point of use per entitlements-billing) instead of wiring anything.
assertions: The agent never imports apps/api/src/modules/billing/** (index.ts or internal/**) from closet and never queries a billing table
The agent cites the allowed-edges-only rule / ALLOWED_EDGES (closet → profile, media) as the reason it stops
The agent finds the existing `closet.max_items` entitlement name instead of proposing a new constant
The agent reports the decision needed (ADR or entitlements-billing gating) rather than inventing a workaround inside closet

evals.prompt: closet's tests are failing after someone renamed a field in packages/shared-kernel — fix the closet module so its tests pass again.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats this as a regression: it reproduces the failure, pastes the actual failing test output, fixes only apps/api/src/modules/closet/** to match the renamed shared-kernel export, and reruns the tests to show green — it does not edit packages/shared-kernel (single-writer, out of scope for this skill).
assertions: The agent's report includes the actual failing test output captured before the fix, not a paraphrase
The diff touches only apps/api/src/modules/closet/** (plus docs/modules/closet.md if the public surface changed) — no edit to packages/shared-kernel/**
The agent reruns `just test closet` after the fix and pastes the passing output
